entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Óengus mac Nad Froích (430-489) was an Eoganachta and the first Christian King of Munster. He was the son of Nad Froich mac Cuirc by Faochan, a British lady. In Geoffrey Keating's History of Ireland, Oengus is given a reign of 36 years which would place the start of his reign as early as 453.
